Package com.cab302.vic.service

Class ServiceFactory

java.lang.Object
com.cab302.vic.service.ServiceFactory
public final class ServiceFactory extends Object
Builds the application's services once and hands the same instances to every controller (Factory pattern, held as a Singleton).

Before this class, each controller wired up its own service and DAO, for example new EventService(new SqliteEventDAO(DatabaseManager.getInstance())). That repeated the same construction in five places and tied every controller to SQLite. Controllers now ask the factory for a service and never name a DAO, so the choice of storage is made in exactly one place.

Tests, or a different storage back end, can build a factory from their own DAOs with ServiceFactory(UserDAO, EventDAO, SignupDAO, HoursDAO).
